title: Variables
description: Learn how to declare and use variables in C#.

data.text: Variables are containers for storing data values. In C#, you must specify the type when declaring a variable.

data.title: Variables

items: **Avoid** starting with numbers or special characters

data.title: var Keyword
data.text: Use var when the type is obvious from the right side. It's not dynamic - the type is still determined at compile time.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Declare variables with type or var
data.takeaway: Variables store data in C# programs.
